line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Mayhem.Explorer.SelectRetreatSector
* DESCRIPTION: Selects the nearest safe sector to retreat to.
* Arguments: ship, source, maxJumps
* - $ship: the ship running this script.
* - $source: the sector where the ship was attacked.
* - $maxJumps: how far to search.
* Return: nearest sector with a safe standard route, otherwise lowest-risk reachable sector.
* AUTHOR: DATE: 9 November 2026
* Validation.
* Enumerate connected sectors up to the search limit.
* Will almost always return an adjacent sector, but check for null in case.
* Use the same standard route that the movement command will generally choose.
* An apparently safe destination is not safe if reaching it crosses hostile sectors.
* No route, a looping route, or a route exceeding the permitted radius.
* A safe adjacent sector is already the shortest possible retreat.
* Cache risk+1 so zero-risk sectors remain distinguishable from missing keys.
* Hostile ownership and player/NPC routing restrictions matter even if empty.
* Blacklist adds risk - it's an unfavorable sector.
* Assess hostile ships, not arbitrary maximum-speed thresholds.
* Freighters are non-aggressors; defensive armament alone is not a threat.
* Preserve the special OCV/Phanon relations used by ship.signal.attacked.
* Note: Xenon and OCV never use explorers.
* Everything else.
